description: Receivable assets on target chain for a source token. Same-chain trading→list_swap_tokens.

account_id.description: User account ID. Only used when wallet is empty, to look up wallet addresses.

chain.description: Target chain identifier, e.g. bsc, arbitrum, polygon

search.description: Search keyword (token symbol or contract address) to filter results

search_auth.description: When searching, only return certified tokens. Only effective when search is non-empty.

source_address.description: Source token contract address on the source chain

source_chain.description: Source chain identifier, e.g. eth, bsc, solana

wallet.description: User wallet address(es), comma-separated. Used to show balances and favorites.
